extracted.name: Parmesan-Roasted Acorn Squash
extracted.description: These roasted acorn squash slices are coated with fresh thyme, black pepper, and Parmesan for a cheesy, caramelized side dish perfect for fall.
ingredient_lines: 1 (2 pound) acorn squash - halved lengthwise, seeded, and cut into 3/4-inch slices
0.5 teaspoon kosher salt, or to taste
0.25 teaspoon ground black pepper, or to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Toss squash slices, Parmesan, thyme sprigs, oil, salt, and pepper together in a bowl until squash is evenly coated.
Transfer to a jelly roll pan and spread in a single layer.
Roast in the preheated oven until squash is golden brown and tender, 25 to 30 minutes.
